# TAPinto

> TAPinto is a hyperlocal news and community platform delivering breaking news, events, real estate, and obituaries across New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Florida.

TAPinto serves as a digital hub for local communities, aggregating news, events, and real estate information while offering franchise opportunities for entrepreneurs looking to launch their own local news operations.

## Key Topics

- local news
- community events
- real estate
- franchise opportunity
- New Jersey towns
- breaking news
- entrepreneur
- digital marketing
- obituaries
- startup guide
- community business
- education
- government

## Core Platform

- [TAPinto - Local News, Events, Real Estate, Obituaries](http://app.tapinto.net/): Main TAPinto platform providing local news, community events, real estate listings, and obituaries across Florida, New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania

## Franchise & Startup

- [Start TAPinto](https://marketing.tapinto.net/start-tapinto): Franchise opportunity and startup guide for entrepreneurs interested in launching their own TAPinto local news operation
